curated-bebas-neue-gf-vollkorn: Bebas Neue stacks its rod-like capitals into a tight, thick band, ideal for a class reunion poster, say. Vollkorn follows as a text serif with a faintly modulated line, comfortable until the heading shrinks and loses its punch.
curated-bebas-neue-libre-baskerville: Libre Baskerville stretches sideways with a bookish, refined stance and only a restrained shift between stem and joining stroke, set against tall, tightly clustered capitals. Its lowercase sits moderate and calm.
curated-berkshire-swash-gf-noto-sans-egy: Berkshire Swash is ornate but quiet, with bold downstrokes and ghostly upstrokes.  Noto Sans Egyptian Hieroglyphs answers with open, approachable letters and towering capitals, though it is not built for paragraph after paragraph.
curated-boska-gf-abel: Abel runs close-set like beads on a thread, every stroke bent from the same tubing. Boska brings the drama with a broad-nib pen's fat downstrokes and threadlike upstrokes, so a long page would feel steady and unfussy beneath it.
curated-boska-gf-barlow-condensed: Dramatic and bookish, Boska has razor-thin serifs on dense black pillars. Barlow Condensed packs its monotone letters like matchsticks, so the heading carries the mood while the body simply carries the words.
curated-boska-gf-beiruti: Boska cuts steep thick-thin strokes, handy for a jewelry brand logo, perhaps. Beiruti keeps a monoline skeleton with wide entrances into each letter, so extended text would flow quickly and without any fuss.
curated-boska-gf-economica: Dramatic Boska, with its thick-and-thin rhythm, could front a true crime podcast cover. Economica packs tubelike, constant-weight letters tightly together, which suits quick reading while the heading handles the theatrics.
curated-boska-gf-finlandica: Finlandica traces a constant-width outline you could follow with a finger, with open-mouthed e crossbars. Boska's sturdy verticals and feathery horizontals sit above it, giving a page a bookish crown and a modern, clean floor.
curated-boska-gf-harmattan: Harmattan draws contrast-free strokes with tight spacing and wide, barely curled s curves. Boska's hairlines nearly vanish beside its stems, so if the heading goes small, those fine strokes get lost.
curated-boska-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight bends its lines like rope, with short ascenders, for a home inspection report, say. Boska delivers heavy stems and hairline thins for drama, while the body keeps every stroke visible.
